channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Jay Shah meets Jammu & Kashmir cricket team after historic Ranji Trophy win
item.description: After scripting history by winning their maiden Ranji Trophy title, the J&K cricket team met ICC Chairman Jay Shah, who congratulated the players for their remarkable achievement. The BCCI described the victory as a landmark moment for cricket in the region and praised the team's grit and perseverance.

item.title: US won't let India become a rival like China, says Trump's deputy secretary Christopher Landau
item.description: US Deputy Secretary of State Christopher Landau said that the US is very excited about the trade deal with India that is 'almost at the finish line' and added that the deal could unlocking almost limitless potential between the two nations. However, he gave a stern rider to Indian leadership with his subtle, veiled remark.

item.title: Gold, silver prices surge over US-Iran war tensions, softer dollar
item.description: MCX gold April futures gained 0.64 per cent to Rs 1,60,700 per 10 grams on an intra-day basis. Meanwhile MCX silver May futures gained 1.87 per cent to Rs 2,67,100 per kg.

item.title: Messi, Inter Miami honoured at White House
item.description: Trump hosts 2025 MLS champions Inter Miami and Lionel Messi at the White House, highlighting the league's rapid growth and rise as a global destination for top players.

item.title: High winds clear Delhi-NCR's air putting most areas in Yellow Zone; temp continues to rise
item.description: Strong winds over the past few days have improved air quality in Delhi-NCR, bringing most areas, including Delhi, Noida, and Ghaziabad, into the moderate Yellow Zone. While pollution has eased, rising temperatures hint at a scorching summer ahead.

item.title: IAF confirms loss of two pilots in Sukhoi Su-30MKI Fighter aircraft crash, expresses condolences
item.description: The Indian Air Force (IAF) confirmed the death of Squadron Leader Anuj and Flight Lieutenant Purvesh Duragkar in the crash of a Sukhoi Su-30MKI fighter aircraft during a routine training mission in Karbi Anglong, Assam, about 60 km from Jorhat.

item.title: Trump says Cuba is next; wants to finish Iran first
item.description: US President Donald Trump said his administration aims to resolve the Iran war before shifting focus to Cuba, signaling a potential change in US foreign policy. Speaking at the White House during an event for MLS champions Inter Miami CF, he emphasized that ending the Iran conflict is the immediate priority.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty post early losses amid weak global cues
item.description: As of 9.28 am, Sensex lost 365 points, or 0.46 per cent, to reach 79,650 and Nifty dipped 103 points, or 0.42 per cent to reach 24,662.

item.title: Kuwait says 67 military personnel injured, hundreds of missiles, drones intercepted
item.description: The escalation follows joint Israeli-US attacks on Tehran that killed Iran's Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei and others, prompting waves of missile and drone strikes across the Middle East. Qatar and other Gulf nations also intercepted missiles and drones, highlighting regional readiness against external threats.

item.title: US grants 30-day waiver for India to buy Russian oil; global oil prices drop
item.description: The US has granted India a 30-day waiver to import Russian crude stranded at sea. The temporary measure applies only to shipments loaded before early March and delivered to Indian ports. It aims to stabilise energy markets amid Middle East tensions, and global oil prices dropped following the announcement.
